content: Rui started swimming lessons on Saturday mornings in March, at the Marrowbrook leisure centre pool.
The house has a small greenhouse in the back garden, Jordan uses it to start seedlings for client projects sometimes.
Sam's birthday is in June, usually a quiet dinner rather than a big thing.
The work mailbox is used for all client and supplier correspondence, personal mailbox is family and admin only.
The task app syncs across Jordan's phone and the studio desktop, but not to Sam's phone.
The notes app is organised by client name for project notes, and by month for general studio notes.
The college mailbox only gets checked once or twice a week, mostly for messages from students.
The calendar app shows three separate calendars overlaid: studio, personal, and the college course.
The bank app sends a push notification for any payment over five hundred pounds, useful for catching mistakes.
The Thornfield portal needs a login refresh every ninety days or it logs everyone out without warning.
The invoicing tool lets Dana see draft invoices before they are sent, she reviews most of them before they go out.
The task app's recurring task feature does not handle monthly tasks well, they sometimes duplicate.
The notes app has a folder called Ideas where half formed planting concepts get dumped for later.
RULE: Studio invoices go out on the last working day of the month, not spread through the month.
RULE: Client site visits always get a follow up email within 24 hours summarising what was agreed.
RULE: Priya handles all planting plan drawings, Tomasz handles all site logistics, keep that split clean.
RULE: New client enquiries get a reply within two working days, even if it is just to say the studio is busy.
RULE: Any plant substitution on a confirmed order needs sign off from Jordan, not just whoever is doing the order.
Dana Okafor does the studio's books quarterly, plus the annual return in the spring.
The studio's VAT registration threshold was crossed last year, all invoices now show VAT separately.
Fernline Studio pays Thornfield Growers on 30 day terms, most other small suppliers are paid on receipt.
The studio's business savings account is separate from the current account, used for tax setting aside.
Dana flagged that the studio should keep three months of expenses as a buffer, working toward that target.
The evening course covers planting design basics over eight sessions, mostly slides and a couple of site walks.
Marrowbrook Community College pays Jordan per session, invoiced through the college's own finance system, not Fernline's invoicing tool.
Course materials get shared with students through the college's own portal, not through Fernline Studio's notes app.
One student in the spring course works at a garden centre and often has useful supplier tips.
The college's evening classes run September to December and January to March, no course over the summer.
Tomasz coaches a five a side football team on Sunday mornings, sometimes affects Monday energy levels.
The studio subscribes to a gardening trade magazine, copies pile up in the front office.
Priya is allergic to bee stings, keeps an EpiPen in her site bag as a precaution.
Oakridge Housing Co-op's board meets on the first Tuesday of the month, decisions on bigger spend need to go through them.
Halden Parks Trust requires hi vis vests for anyone on site, spares are kept in the studio van.
The Whitlow family have a cat that likes to sit in freshly dug soil, Tomasz covers new beds with mesh overnight.
Studio lunch is usually whatever is nearby on Mill Lane, there is a decent sandwich shop two doors down.
Jordan prefers client meetings in the morning, afternoons get used for drawing and admin.
The studio uses a shared password manager for the supplier portal and bank app logins, Dana has access too.
Rui's nursery key worker is called Fen, she does the daily handover chat at pickup.
Sam handles most of the household admin, bills and insurance, Jordan handles studio side admin.
The Marrowbrook council planning office is only open for enquiries Tuesday to Thursday.
